name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd
title: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd - 543412 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 combined ratio improved to 95.7% and loss ratio fell to 65.2% (from 69.2%), but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and the gain is still being tested across cycles.

triggers.label: Loss ratio 69.2% → 65.2% YoY
triggers.quote: a 4% improvement from 69.2% in Q4 FY25 to 65.2% in Q4 FY26

triggers.label: Reprice ~80% of book by Q1
triggers.quote: We are expecting to reprice almost 80% of the book between what we started from Q4 going up to Q1 this year.

triggers.label: Retail renewal volume retention 86-87%
triggers.quote: on volume basis, we have seen almost close to 86-87% retention in terms of volume

triggers.label: Normalised ROE 13.1% FY26
triggers.quote: ROE expanded from 10.1% in FY25 to 13.1% in FY26
triggers.highlight: ROE expanded from 10.1% in FY25 to 13.1%

triggers.label: Q4 MTM loss Rs 558 crore
triggers.quote: led to a Rs. 558 crore marked-to-market loss during the quarter

guidance.quote: to have a sustainable high-teen growth, and a sustainable, hopefully mid-teen to high-teen ROEs

red_flags.label: Normalised PAT used to smooth reported profit
red_flags.quote: we are adopting a concept of normalized investment yield, pegged at 8% on annualized basis

red_flags.label: Growth below industry; NEP lagging GWP
red_flags.quote: why is NEP growth still lagging the GWP growth?

red_flags.label: EoM compliance question evaded
red_flags.quote: Sir, this is a very difficult question for me to answer. I think I will give it a pass.

evasions.quote: Sir, this is a very difficult question for me to answer. I think I will give it a pass.

evasions.topic: Fresh premium long-term vs annual split
evasions.quote: as far as the breakups of long term and all that is concerned, we will give it to you separately.
It's a sum of all parts, right? It's not one can lay a finger on any one particular item.
